description: Downsampled copies of the SRA runs the end-to-end test uses, committed so the default e2e runs offline with no downloads. Each is a seeded subsample of the full run the e2e used to fetch at runtime. The full runs are still exercised by the e2e_full tier (NVD_E2E_USE_SRA=1), which keeps the FETCH_FASTQ/sracha download path under test. Re-create any file with the commands below: the downsample is byte-reproducible with seqkit 2.13.0.
maintainer_note: sample_id deliberately matches the FULL run's sample id rather than carrying an _s42 suffix. The parity check compares the reduced run against a recording keyed on full-run sample ids, so matching ids keep that comparison an identity map and keep every downstream assertion working unchanged. The _s42 provenance marker lives in the file names instead. Fractions were chosen so each fixture keeps thousands of target-virus reads, well above the measured assembly floor of roughly 1,000 viral pairs. Do NOT lower them without re-checking viral_reads_deacon: a fixture that loses its virus would make the e2e assert nothing. Mates stay in sync because R1 and R2 are given the same seed, which a test verifies rather than assumes.
